title: I made a browser survivor game where the alien hive studies your build and evolves to counter it. Looking for honest feedback on difficulty and balance
author: KyzenDragon666

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/KyzenDragon666 please add a bit about how you used AI and what the development process looked like. A mention that AI was involved isn't enough. It needs dev details. Rule 4 exists so promotional posts contribute to the conversation about making games. We want to avoid the sub getting drowned in low effort promotion. If this isn't updated, it may be removed.

comments.author: Prestigious_Edge_472
comments.body:
That dash skill has to go or become an active skill, it's terrible for gameplay.

I didn't really feel that enemies were evolving, I think you'd have to make this part clearer for the players so they understand how their choices affected the enemy? 

You should make the obstacles clearer, they need to be more distinct in looks/colors considering they can help you or get you killed.
